items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Yeah, we were raised together. That's the same as Frank Paisley. The same.

ctx.x: And you kept playing music up until yesterday? No. Do you know Frank Paisley? Real bright fellow?
That's the same fellow. Yeah. It's different than his name. Some people. Red. He was up there. He called him Paisley. Brother Red.
